items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I put him up there -- Howk Benny and the (inaudible) class. For the type of playing he could do. He was good. He was really good.

ctx.x: Eddie's wanted to (inaudible) try to get his tone straightened out (inaudible). And these were two great tenor players back in those days. Ike Quebec was one of the finest, you know. Ike Quebec was real fine. That was -- people don't talk about him. Nobody really talk about that man, but he was really way up there on top.
